title: "livelihood transitions and food security among bedouin and pastoralist communities in the levant and east africa: a systematic review"

notes: This data supports a systematic literature review applying the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) framework to examine how food security among pastoral communities in the Levant and East Africa has been conceptualized and measured. Literature searches were conducted in Scopus and Web of Science, and 69 peer-reviewed articles were included in the final synthesis, of which details are provided here.
